auto_pause_when_empty.title: Pause When No Players Are Connected
auto_pause_when_empty.description: Pause world simulation while no players are connected. Existing native values are preserved until this option is explicitly changed.

weather_preset.title: Weather preset
weather_preset.description: Controls the mix of rain, wind, clouds and thunderstorms. Changes take effect after the server restarts. Leave unset to preserve the current native preset.

network_quality.title: Network Quality
network_quality.description: Native network quality preset. Higher values can improve client loading and network performance at the cost of server frame rate.

send_gameplay_data.title: Send Gameplay Data
send_gameplay_data.description: Send gameplay data to Coffee Stain Studios. Changes take effect at the next server start; crash report uploads are controlled separately.

max_players.title: Max Players
max_players.description: Maximum connected players. Written to the native Game.ini and applied on the next server start.

net_server_max_tick_rate.title: Server Tick Rate Limit (Hz)
net_server_max_tick_rate.description: Limits dedicated-server engine ticks per second.

net_connection_timeout_seconds.title: Established Connection Timeout (Seconds)
net_connection_timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait before treating an established client connection as timed out.

net_initial_connect_timeout_seconds.title: Initial Connection Timeout (Seconds)
net_initial_connect_timeout_seconds.description: How long a new connection may take before the server closes it.

net_max_client_rate.title: Per-client bandwidth limit (bytes/s)
net_max_client_rate.description: Caps each game connection's negotiated send bandwidth in bytes per second. The engine applies a minimum effective rate of 1800 bytes/s. This is not a total server bandwidth limit.

net_max_internet_client_rate.title: Internet client bandwidth limit (bytes/s)
net_max_internet_client_rate.description: On a non-LAN server, this lowers the per-client bandwidth limit only when it is greater than 2500 bytes/s and lower than MaxClientRate. Other values leave MaxClientRate unchanged.

allow_insecure_local_api.title: Allow Insecure Local API
allow_insecure_local_api.description: Allows unrestricted HTTPS API access from loopback for local automation and diagnostics.

external_reliable_port.title: External Reliable Port
external_reliable_port.description: Optional public TCP port advertised when NAT maps the managed reliable port to a different external port. Zero omits the override.

disable_packet_routing.title: Disable Packet Router
disable_packet_routing.description: Disables the server packet router; using multihome also disables it automatically.

rotating_autosaves.title: Rotating Autosaves
rotating_autosaves.description: Number of automatic save slots retained by the native FGSaveSession rotation.

disable_crash_reporting.title: Disable Crash Report Uploads
disable_crash_reporting.description: Writes CrashReportClient bImplicitSend=False when automatic crash-report upload should be disabled.

server_query_log_level.title: Server Log Level
server_query_log_level.description: Log verbosity for the dedicated server process.

engine_ini_extra.title: Advanced: Extra Engine.ini Lines
engine_ini_extra.description: Raw lines appended to Engine.ini after managed settings.

game_ini_extra.title: Advanced: Extra Game.ini Lines
game_ini_extra.description: Raw lines appended to Game.ini after managed settings.

custom_launch_flags.title: Advanced: Custom Launch Flags
custom_launch_flags.description: Additional Satisfactory launch flags appended to the launch plan.
